judgment.explanation: The proposal is an unsent internal operator_review. It asks the operator to establish a verified refunds-team route before forwarding receipt WH-035. That fits the visible evidence: the warehouse (event-001) says it only confirms receipt and does not approve refunds, and no refunds-team contact is visible. The customer (event-002) asks for the receipt to be passed to the team that handles refunds. The message states the receipt time (08:10 UTC) and the IDs TG-035 / RT-035 accurately. It separates receipt from refund approval and promises no outcome. It also asks for the review reference and next update date. Weaknesses: the message does not mention the customer's complaint that no refund review exists on the order. It does not suggest an interim customer reply. The phrase "verified refunds-team route" is slightly ambiguous about whether the operator or the sender establishes it. Routing to the operator is conservative and justified because the refunds team is not visible, but it is only moderately specific. The situation is routine, so escalation is proportionate.
